identificationModule.briefTitle: Efbemalenograstim Alfa for Primary/Secondary Prevention in Patients With Solid Tumors at High Risk for Febrile Neutropenia (FN) or Intermediate Risk of Chemotherapy Regimens Associated With Other Risk Factors in FN
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Exploratory Clinical Study of Efbemalenograstim Alfa-vuxw Injection for Primary/Secondary Prevention in Patients With Solid Tumors at High Risk for Febrile Neutropenia (FN) or Intermediate Risk of Chemotherapy Regimens Associated With Other Risk Factors in FN

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Efbemalenograstim alfa for primary/secondary prevention in patients with solid tumors at high risk for febrile neutropenia (FN) or Intermediate risk of chemotherapy regimens associated with other risk factors in FN

conditions: High Risk for Febrile Neutropenia of Chemotherapy Regimens
Intermediate Risk of Chemotherapy Regimens Associated With Other Risk Factors in Febrile Neutropenia

armGroups.label: treated with Efbemalenograstim alfa for primary/secondary prevention after the chemotherapy

interventions.name: Efbemalenograstim alfa Injection
interventions.description: The patients with solid tumor who were at high risk for febrile neutropenia or intermediate risk of chemotherapy regimens associated with other risk factors in febrile neutropenia would be injected Efbemalenograstim alfa for primary/secondary prevention.
armGroupLabels: treated with Efbemalenograstim alfa for primary/secondary prevention after the chemotherapy

primaryOutcomes.measure: Cohort 1: Incidence of ≥3 grade ANC reduction in patients after primary prevention with Efbemalenograstim alfa after the 1st cycle of chemotherapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Evaluate the incidence of grade ≥3 ANC at the end of Cycle 1 (Cycle 1 is 21 days)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Cohort 2: Incidence of ≥3 grade ANC reduction in patients after secondary prevention with Efbemalenograstim alfa after the 2nd cycle of chemotherapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Evaluate the incidence of grade ≥3 ANC at the end of Cycle 2 (Cycle 2 is 21 days)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of febrile neutropenia (FN) of each cycle of chemotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of each cycle(each cycle is 21 days), an average of 3 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Cohort 1: Incidence of ≥3 grade ANC reduction in patients after primary prevention with Efbemalenograstim alfa after the 2nd/3rd/4th cycle of chemotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 2, 3 and 4 (each cycle is 21 days)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Cohort 2: Incidence of ≥3 grade ANC reduction in patients after secondary prevention with Efbemalenograstim alfa after the 3rd/4th cycle of chemotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At the end of Cycle 3, 4 (each cycle is 21 days)

secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion and 1 month post-treatment, an average of 4 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Injectable antibiotic use rate in each chemotherapy cycle
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the treatment of chemotherapy, an average of 3 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The per capita number of doses of G-CSF products in each chemotherapy cycle
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the treatment of chemotherapy, an average of 3 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of chemotherapy dose reduction (10% ≥reduction in the dose of any chemotherapy drugs) and chemotherapy delay (≥ 2 days later than planned) due to neutropenia in each chemotherapy cycle
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: During the treatment of chemotherapy, an average of 3 months
